title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Triple Mango
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Triple Mango Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This tropical refill option includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a rich, mango-focused blend. Triple Mango brings together three distinct Mango flavour notes to create a deep, sweet and aromatic vape that’s smooth on the inhale and satisfyingly fruity on the exhale. It’s a great choice for lovers of bold tropical fruit flavours with a sunny, exotic character. Each pod and refill pack is designed exclusively for the Dojo Blast 10K device and offers up to 10,000 puffs (device total), powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour.
